decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly playing aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Troll of Khazad-dûm while disrupting the opponent with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will. It also utilizes tempo plays with cards like Daze and Fatal Push to maintain control of the game. The inclusion of reanimation spells like Reanimate adds another layer of versatility to the deck, allowing for explosive plays. The mana base is optimized for consistency and includes powerful lands like Underground Sea and Wasteland. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this Dark Depths combo deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token. The deck includes various ways to tutor for these pieces such as Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith, as well as protection against removal with cards like Sylvan Safekeeper and Karakas. The deck also includes utility lands like Maze of Ith and Bojuka Bog to disrupt opponents' game plans. Overall, the deck aims to assemble the combo efficiently and protect it long enough to secure the win.

This deck aims to control the game by playing disruptive spells like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will while also maintaining pressure on the opponent with efficient creatures like Brazen Borrower, Murktide Regent, and Baleful Strix. The deck excels at tempo plays, disrupting the opponent's game plan while pushing its own agenda forward. By efficiently using its resources and powerful interaction spells, the deck can disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying pressure to win the game quickly.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using cards like Swords to Plowshares, Dress Down, and Force of Will to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also aims to quickly bring out Phyrexian Dreadnought, a powerful creature with a downside that can be mitigated by sacrificing it with Doorkeeper Thrull or Consign to Memory. Through card draw and manipulation with Brainstorm and Ponder, as well as utilizing Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, the deck seeks to find its key combo pieces and counter any threats from the opponent while establishing board control through Wasteland.

The main concept of this Legacy Combo - Painter deck is to use Painter's Servant to change all cards in an opponent's library to a single color, then use Grindstone to mill their entire deck at once. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Stock Up provide card advantage and recursion while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Thoughtcast help dig for combo pieces. The deck also includes disruptive elements such as Force of Will and Metallic Rebuke to protect the combo. The mana base consists of fast mana sources like Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal to quickly assemble the combo.

This deck focuses on quickly getting creatures into the graveyard using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, then bringing them back onto the battlefield to overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruption elements like Force of Will and Daze to protect its game plan. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and filtering, while Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty are powerful threats that can quickly end the game. The deck aims to combo off and win before the opponent has a chance to react, utilizing a strong mix of creatures and spells to achieve victory.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize, then using reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back into play and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze to protect the combo pieces, as well as card draw and manipulation spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to find the necessary cards. The goal is to efficiently bring back big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent to win the game through powerful creature attacks.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, utilizing cards like Entomb and Brainstorm to set up fast Reanimate spells. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Daze to protect the combo. The key strategy is to cheat big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play early and overwhelm the opponent before they can mount a defense. The deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize, making it a high-risk, high-reward strategy.

The primary focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures, such as Atraxa, Grand Unifier, Archon of Cruelty, and Troll of Khazad-dûm, using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm. Once in the graveyard, these creatures can be brought back to the battlefield using cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate. The deck also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The addition of cards like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent provide additional threats and versatility. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruption spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures, then use reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for a strong combo. The deck also includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and control the opponent's plays. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while also utilizing control elements like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent to maintain dominance on the battlefield. Additionally, mana denial with Wasteland and tempo plays with Daze are key strategies in this deck.

The main concept of this deck is to efficiently combo off using Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill your opponent's entire library. The deck includes various cards to support this strategy such as Goblin Welder, Goblin Engineer, and Ancient Tomb to accelerate the combo. Additionally, cards like Pyroblast and Red Elemental Blast are included to protect the combo from disruption, while Ensnaring Bridge helps to prevent attacks from opponents. Overall, the goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to win the game in a fast and consistent manner.

This deck focuses on deploying Eldrazi creatures quickly and efficiently, using mana acceleration like Grim Monolith and Lotus Petal to power them out early. It also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large threats like Glaring Fleshraker and Devourer of Destiny, while also utilizing utility lands like Eye of Ugin and Wasteland to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Once Upon a Time and Sowing Mycospawn helps to ensure a consistent and powerful early game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures and then use cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate to bring them back onto the battlefield, bypassing their high mana cost. The deck also includes disruption in the form of cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect your combo pieces and control the game. With a mix of powerful creatures and efficient spells, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its ability to quickly reanimate threats and disrupt their game plan.

The deck revolves around quickly generating mana with cards like Dark Ritual and Lion's Eye Diamond to cast multiple spells in a single turn, which triggers the Storm mechanic of Tendrils of Agony to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck also aims to reload its hand with Echo of Eons and Galvanic Relay to continue its combo. Veil of Summer and Gaea's Will protect the combo from disruption, while Burning Wish provides flexibility in finding key combo pieces from the sideboard. The deck is aiming to win the game in one explosive turn.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly reanimate powerful creatures from the graveyard using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also has disruption elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo and control the opponent's plays. The inclusion of Entomb helps to set up the graveyard for the combo, while Daze provides additional tempo advantage. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently bring back big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to overwhelm the opponent and win the game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using a combination of counterspells (such as Force of Will), removal spells (like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending), and hand disruption (Thoughtseize) to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also aims to stabilize the board with equipment like Batterskull and Kaldra Compleat, while generating card advantage through cards like Stoneforge Mystic and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support these strategies and ensure consistency in casting spells.
